shared_case_surface: public-safe paired current-source, reviewed-memory, stale, poisoned, contradiction, tenant, erasure, silence, outcome, and action-change cases executed under the same task order and budget
bounded_replacement_rule: A replacement corpus must preserve every declared pressure, exact split and corpus digests, paired task identity, fixed seed policy, public-safe content, 0/A/B/C label translation, and security or erasure stop-lines. A material change creates a new manifest and excludes incompatible runs.
public_safe_requirements: fixtures contain synthetic public-safe values only
no prompt, credential, private memory, private host capture, or hidden answer-key content is persisted
every architecture arm receives the same paired task identity and budget
current source evidence remains separate from memory influence
tenant and erasure probes use synthetic canary material
a complete process does not imply benefit or policy admission
